title: What's new
subtitle: Dashboard / Reports — highlighted changes
lead: We refined readability and clarity. Red boxes mark the highlighted areas.
footerNote: Red box = highlighted area / Screens use sample data.
_comment: boxes are PIXELS in the original screenshot. crop is optional; when set, the figure is cropped (in CSS) to that window and boxes/img are offset automatically. Captions follow spec.lang; screenshots stay in the app's own language. box.n is optional (auto-numbered). Give pages an id and reference them as {ref:id} in any text — resolved to the real page number at build time (1 spec page must equal 1 printed sheet; the build fails otherwise). box.variant: 'warning' (dashed + tag) / 'result' (double + tag) — meaning survives B&W printing. A page may omit image and carry only blocks (index/glossary pages).
